mapper.sql: ar.ABR_SN AS reportSn, ar.ABR_TYPE_CD AS reportTypeCode, rt.CMM_NM AS reportTypeName, ar.ABR_TRG_NM AS targetName, ar.ABR_REF_TYPE_CD AS referenceTypeCode, ar.ABR_REF_SN AS referenceSn, ar.ABR_TITLE_NM AS title, ar.ABR_CN AS content, ar.ABR_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, st.CMM_NM AS statusName, ar.ABR_PROC_RSN_CN AS processReason, ar.ABR_REG_DT AS registeredAt, ar.ABR_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt

ABR_SN AS reportSn, RSK_EVT_SN AS riskEventSn, RPRT_USR_SN AS reporterUserSn, RPTD_USR_SN AS reportedUserSn, ABR_TYPE_CD AS reportTypeCode, (SELECT CMM_NM FROM CMM_CODE WHERE CMM_CD = ABR_TYPE_CD LIMIT 1) AS reportTypeName, CASE WHEN ABR_TYPE_CD IN ('ABRC0016', 'ABRC0017', 'ABRC0018', 'ABRC0019') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE_DISPUTE classifiedDispute WHERE classifiedDispute.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN ) THEN 'TRADE_ISSUE' ELSE 'GENERAL' END AS caseType, ABR_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, ABR_TITLE_NM AS title, ABR_TRG_NM AS targetName, ABR_CN AS content, ABR_REF_TYPE_CD AS referenceTypeCode, ABR_REF_SN AS referenceSn, ABR_PROC_RSN_CN AS processReason, ABR_PROC_REQ_ID AS processRequestId, (SELECT d.TRD_DSP_SN FROM TRADE_DISPUTE d WHERE d.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN LIMIT 1) AS linkedDisputeSn, (SELECT d.TRD_DSP_TYPE_CD FROM TRADE_DISPUTE d WHERE d.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN LIMIT 1) AS linkedDisputeTypeCode, (SELECT d.TRD_DSP_STATUS_CD FROM TRADE_DISPUTE d WHERE d.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN LIMIT 1) AS linkedDisputeStatusCode, (SELECT d.TRD_DSP_RSLT_CD FROM TRADE_DISPUTE d WHERE d.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN LIMIT 1) AS linkedDisputeResultCode, (SELECT d.TRD_DSP_PREV_TRD_STATUS_CD FROM TRADE_DISPUTE d WHERE d.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN LIMIT 1) AS linkedPreviousTradeStatusCode, CASE WHEN ABR_STATUS_CD IN ('ABRC0007', 'ABRC0008') THEN ABR_UPDT_ID ELSE NULL END AS processedBy, ABR_REG_DT AS registeredAt, CASE WHEN ABR_STATUS_CD IN ('ABRC0007', 'ABRC0008') THEN ABR_UPDT_DT ELSE NULL END AS processedAt

where.if: AND ABR_TYPE_CD NOT IN ('ABRC0016', 'ABRC0017', 'ABRC0018', 'ABRC0019') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE_DISPUTE caseDispute WHERE caseDispute.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN )
AND ( ABR_TYPE_CD IN ('ABRC0016', 'ABRC0017', 'ABRC0018', 'ABRC0019') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE_DISPUTE caseDispute WHERE caseDispute.ABR_SN = ABUSE_REPORT.ABR_SN ) )

AND ( CAST(ABR_SN AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(RPRT_USR_SN AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(RPTD_USR_SN AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ABR_TYPE_CD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ABR_REF_TYPE_CD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(ABR_REF_SN AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ABR_TITLE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ABR_TRG_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ABR_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ABR_PROC_RSN_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ABUSE_REPORT ( RSK_EVT_SN, RPRT_USR_SN, RPTD_USR_SN, ABR_TYPE_CD, ABR_STATUS_CD, ABR_REF_TYPE_CD, ABR_REF_SN, ABR_CN, ABR_REG_ID, ABR_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{riskEventSn}, #{reporterUserSn}, #{reportedUserSn}, #{reportTypeCode}, #{statusCode}, #{referenceTypeCode}, #{referenceSn}, #{content}, #{registeredBy}, #{updatedBy} )

INSERT INTO ABUSE_REPORT ( RSK_EVT_SN, RPRT_USR_SN, RPTD_USR_SN, ABR_TYPE_CD, ABR_STATUS_CD, ABR_REF_TYPE_CD, ABR_REF_SN, ABR_CN, ABR_REG_ID, ABR_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( NULL, #{reporterUserSn}, #{reportedUserSn}, #{reportTypeCode}, #{statusCode}, #{referenceTypeCode}, #{referenceSn}, #{content}, #{registeredBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT ABR_SN AS reportSn, ABR_REF_SN AS referenceSn, ABR_STATUS_CD AS statusCode FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE RPRT_USR_SN = #{reporterUserSn} AND ABR_REF_TYPE_CD = #{referenceTypeCode} ORDER BY ABR_SN DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ABUSE_REPORT ( RSK_EVT_SN, RPRT_USR_SN, RPTD_USR_SN, ABR_TYPE_CD, ABR_STATUS_CD, ABR_REF_TYPE_CD, ABR_REF_SN, ABR_TITLE_NM, ABR_TRG_NM, ABR_CN, ABR_REG_ID, ABR_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( NULL, #{reporterUserSn}, #{reportedUserSn}, #{reportTypeCode}, #{statusCode}, #{referenceTypeCode}, #{referenceSn}, #{title}, #{targetName}, #{content}, #{registeredBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ABUSE_REPORT ar LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE rt ON rt.CMM_CD = ar.ABR_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE st ON st.CMM_CD = ar.ABR_STATUS_CD WHERE ar.ABR_SN = #{reportSn} AND ar.RPRT_USR_SN = #{reporterUserSn} AND ar.RSK_EVT_SN IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ABUSE_REPORT_FILE ( ABR_SN, FL_SN, ABR_FL_SORT_NO, ABR_FL_REG_ID, ABR_FL_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{reportSn}, #{fileSn}, #{sortNo}, #{actorId}, #{actorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT f.FL_SN AS fileSn, f.FL_ORG_NM AS originalName, f.FL_EXT AS extension, f.FL_SIZE_AMT AS sizeAmount, rf.ABR_FL_SORT_NO AS sortNo FROM ABUSE_REPORT_FILE rf JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = rf.FL_SN WHERE rf.ABR_SN = #{reportSn} AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY rf.ABR_FL_SORT_NO, rf.ABR_FL_SN
SELECT ABR_SN FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE RSK_EVT_SN = #{riskEventSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ABR_SN AS reportSn, RSK_EVT_SN AS riskEventSn, RPRT_USR_SN AS reporterUserSn, RPTD_USR_SN AS reportedUserSn, ABR_TYPE_CD AS reportTypeCode, ABR_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, ABR_REF_TYPE_CD AS referenceTypeCode, ABR_REF_SN AS referenceSn, ABR_CN AS content, ABR_PROC_RSN_CN AS processReason, ABR_PROC_REQ_ID AS processRequestId, ABR_REG_ID AS registeredBy, ABR_UPDT_ID AS updatedBy FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE ABR_SN = #{reportSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ABUSE_REPORT r JOIN TRADE t ON t.TRD_SN = #{tradeSn} WHERE r.ABR_STATUS_CD IN (#{receivedStatusCode}, #{processingStatusCode}) AND (#{excludedReportSn} IS NULL OR r.ABR_SN != #{excludedReportSn}) AND ( (r.ABR_REF_TYPE_CD = 'REFC0005' AND r.ABR_REF_SN = t.TRD_SN) OR (r.ABR_REF_TYPE_CD = 'REFC0007' AND r.ABR_REF_SN = t.SVC_REQ_SN) OR (r.ABR_REF_TYPE_CD = 'REFC0008' AND r.ABR_REF_SN = t.QUT_SN) ) )

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ABUSE_REPORT r WHERE r.ABR_STATUS_CD IN (#{receivedStatusCode}, #{processingStatusCode}) AND (#{excludedReportSn} IS NULL OR r.ABR_SN != #{excludedReportSn}) AND r.ABR_REF_TYPE_CD = 'REFC0003' AND r.ABR_REF_SN = #{auctionSn} )

SELECT
FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE ABR_STATUS_CD IN (#{receivedStatusCode}, #{processingStatusCode}) ORDER BY ABR_REG_DT ASC, ABR_SN ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ABUSE_REPORT SET ABR_STATUS_CD = #{newStatusCode}, ABR_PROC_RSN_CN = #{processReason}, ABR_PROC_REQ_ID = #{requestId}, ABR_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, ABR_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ABR_SN = #{reportSn} AND ABR_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE (RPRT_USR_SN = #{userSn} OR RPTD_USR_SN = #{userSn}) AND ABR_STATUS_CD IN ('ABRC0005', 'ABRC0006')
